title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Amir Garib
desc: A man lives a dual life, that of a magician and the other as a thief whose motive is to help the needy and poor. He falls in love with a girl.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.

title: Raanjhnaa
desc: Kundan has loved Zoya since childhood, but learns she loves another. When he discovers she lied about her fiance's religion, his heartbreak turns into uncontrollable rage and obsession.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
desc: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the man Reena is set to marry, in an attempt to win her love - but he's unprepared for the chaos that follows when the truth comes out.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: John Jani Janardhan
desc: After John is killed, his wife gives birth to twin sons and dies. Twins Jani and Janardhan are pitted against one another by a wily gangster.

title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: Arun blames God for his troubles, but when God appears and grants him divine powers, Arun tries to make the world better by fulfilling everyone's wishes.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Bawaal
desc: A small-town boy falls in love with the most beautiful girl in town. He eventually gets married to her only because he realises that their marriage can help him climb the social ladder.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Race
desc: Two stepbrothers run a lavish stud farm and horse racing empire. When they fall for the same woman, jealousy turns deadly-one plots murder to claim love and insurance money.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.
